title: Static Upright Short-Neck Penguin
description: One newly authored stylised upright penguin-inspired animal exterior. A full thick upright pear-shaped torso, short neck and rounded head form one continuous closed shared-vertex surface. A short broad blunt bill, two long flattened downward-swept flippers, two broad thick web-shaped ground feet with shallow front toe scallops, two small lateral eyes and a short rear tapered tail complete the fixed whole silhouette. The warm pale belly is an integral face-material region of the same torso, not an overlapping shell. Whole body stations, flipper trajectories, bill, feet and tail are new; not a shortened long-legged wading bird, upright old seal or recoloured toy bear. Generic mesh construction and mature export/render tools only are reused. Nine closed editable meshes, four opaque constant matte PBR roles, no textures, fur, feathers or scene. Metres, native Z up, head/front -Y, actual complete horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin, two full finite foot soles. One whole model and zero scenes or separately counted parts. Artistic fixed exterior only: no exact species or biological/anatomical fidelity, swimming, flight, gait, motion, rig, animal care, stability, fit, physical or ecological performance claim.
